s1d1: "Fires a laser after charging. Dont get hit. Lasers linger."
s2d1: - Every 50 seconds Hyperlaser will spawn around the character, After 1.5 seconds of it appearing it will shoot a laser. Upon making contact with the laser, you will instantly die.
s2d2: - Hyperlaser is client-sided, meaning it only appears on your client when it spawns.
s2d3: - Hyperlaser can only spawn after level 20 and a limit of 5 permanant Hyperlaser, with a hard cap of 10
